    def LargeIndecomposable.Contragredient.ofCarrierIso (R : Type u) [Ring R] (M : FGModuleCat R) :
    M ≅ ↧↑M

    Every bundled finitely generated module is canonically isomorphic to the FGModuleCat.of object built from its carrier. The two objects have the same elements and action, but are not definitionally equal because an arbitrary object retains its original ModuleCat wrapper.
